title: n8n automation developer to connect our CRM to Slack and invoicing
description:
We run a 12-person home-services company and need an n8n workflow built that connects our CRM to Slack and our invoicing tool.

Deliverables:
- New-lead alert in Slack within one minute
- Auto-create an invoice draft when a quote is accepted
- Error alerts to a Slack channel when a run fails

We already use HubSpot and Stripe. Timeline is about 3 weeks. Success means no lead is missed and invoices go out the same day. Please share one example of a similar automation you shipped.
